description: From the Paseo del Collado at night, the walled hilltop town of Laguardia glows faintly in moonlight beneath a starry sky. prompts.prompt-r1.txt: Photorealistic artistic interpretation of the walled town of Laguardia, Álava, Spain, at night. IMPORTANT: no floodlighting — the medieval hilltop town lies mostly dark under moonlight and a starry sky. Its 13th-century walls and gates catch faint cool moonlight; a few warm windows glow in the honey-coloured streets; the Sierra de Cantabria dark on the horizon, vineyards sleeping below. Quiet, honest night mood. No identifiable people prominent. Subject centred so it survives a 4:5 centre crop. No text or brand logos anywhere, no on-image text at all.
